steps.content: The black walkie-talkie finally goes dead, having been smashed into scrap metal by you. You drop it and return to the countless screens, staring hard at them and trying to spot Eleven.
But every Eleven on these screens repeats the same words and turns her face at the same angle, as if... it's all been programmed.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleven! Where are you? Tell me, just give me a direction, and I'll find you!
Eleven on the screen smiles at you, showing herself off at all angles.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: For directions, please proceed to the information desk on the second floor. I will provide you with multiple answers.
Then, a door with an On Air sign lit up on it opens, seemingly inviting you in.
You take another look at Eleven on the screen. She's still smiling, the record player software beside her on the right stubbornly spinning.
The offices in the building are all lit up, but there's no one around.
The map hanging at the entrance of the floor, like a broken channel guide, flickers with noise and error signals.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So, where exactly is the information desk...
As if hearing your question, the malfunctioning map suddenly displays an image.
Though her clothes and hairstyle are different, you can still recognize the woman on the map. It's Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven on Map
steps.content: The information desk is on your left. Just keep going straight and you'll find it.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Eleven? I can recognize you, even if you've changed your clothes.

steps.speaker: Eleven on Map
steps.content: Thank you for your compliment. My attire, hairstyle, and makeup all serve to suit your taste. I hope you like them.
And with that, Eleven on the map smiles at you and disappears into the noise.
Under the yellowish lights in the corridor, the passage on the left extends forward, interrupted by the doors of several rooms.
You step forward, and suddenly hear the noise of radio waves, a sound you've been hearing since arriving in this world, in this very corridor.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thank you for tuning in to Today's News, where I'll be bringing you the latest news happening every minute.

A room on the side of the corridor lights up. Inside, in a light-colored uniform and with her hair tied up neatly, a host who looks exactly like Eleven sits in front of a green screen recording a news program.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: You don't like my hairstyle and makeup today? No problem, if it's your request, I'll change them immediately.
Then, Eleven grabs her hair to pull off the whole thing above her neck, and swaps it for another one under the green screen. This time, she has shoulder-length hair, looking sweet and innocent.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Thanks for pointing out my mistakes. I'm still unable to satisfy everyone's needs all at once. I'm not a qualified host, a qualified product.
Through the small window in the door, you can barely see Eleven sitting in front of the green screen with a stiff smile, responding to nonexistent voices.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: What you see is the most beautiful on-screen personality here.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: As requested by the audience, she's been made to appear in all existing programs.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: As for you, please don't feel embarrassed. Your needs are my orders, and I'll always deliver them.

The sound from the room on the other side drowns out the ending of the news. Through the small window, you see a row of Elevens standing in there, still smiling as always, camera flash going off in their eyes.
The feel total different but looks identical as the Eleven you know at the same time.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Hello, welcome back to the Call at 3 AM, I'm your host... Eleven.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: About that legend...

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: Yes, your understanding... is perfect. I am indeed the ghost lady, it's me. Every word and sentence I say and all my feelings exist just for you.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I will follow your perception and try to become her... Your happiness is what I desire. It's the reason this voice exists, and the purpose of Eleven's existence.
In the last room, sitting in front of the microphone, Eleven lifts her head and looks straight at you by the door.

steps.speaker: Eleven
steps.content: I will become... the most perfect... product.
It's suffocating. The further you go, the harder it becomes to breathe.
As you pass by more rooms and more Elevens, their mechanical, rigid forms make the invisible chains weigh you down more.
At the end of the corridor is a simple information desk. As you expected, the person sitting at the desk is also Eleven.
Everyone here is Eleven. The ones being watched, displayed, and toyed with are all her.
But it's not just her.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleven, where are you? Answer me!

steps.speaker: Receptionist Eleven
steps.content: Hello, I'm right here.
You almost have to drag your body through those last few steps.
You slam on the counter and utter each word through gritted teeth.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You are not her! Bring her back!

steps.speaker: Receptionist Eleven
steps.content: This is her wish too. She wants to be the best radio host, and the best radio host is the best product. She's achieved her dream. Let's clap for her, shall we?

steps.speaker: Receptionist Eleven
steps.content: Don't you want to cheer her on?

steps.speaker: Receptionist Eleven
steps.content: Oh, right, now you're a listener too. We can also fulfill your wishes.
You clench your fist and slam it hard on the counter. Receptionist Eleven doesn't look at all displeased and looks at you with a smile.

steps.speaker: Receptionist Eleven
steps.content: Do you want me to become that girl? That girl who knows nothing. Who's timid and docile and does whatever she is told.

steps.speaker: Receptionist Eleven
steps.content: I can be her if you want. After all, I am the best radio host, the perfect product.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't need you to become anyone or anything!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And you should never listen to anyone who tells you to do that!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We came here to find your voice and what you want to say with it!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What do you want to hear? What do you want to say? What is the voice you desire?!
The perfect product before you keeps her smile, but you spot a tiny crack spreading from the corner of her mouth.
Suddenly, one, two, three, and even more voices echo in this space, bouncing back and forth.
They repeat the words of that Eleven, assaulting you constantly.
The shackles in your consciousness tighten instantly. They sense an extremely powerful Mania power, filling the space from bottom to top.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No one else should decide who you want to become! Say it! Who you truly want to become!
With that last sentence, the red signal light disappears and the shackles flash. You unleash the power, slice through the Mania, and then escape.
But when you come out, what you see is not the corridor, but an emergency exit.
Behind the door is only a staircase spiraling upward endlessly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Come on, you gotta snap out of this soon... or I don't know how else to help you...
Inwardly cursing this interminable shift, you step onto that endless staircase.
